app.name: FORM
app.subtitle: Your training, thoughtfully planned.
app.welcomeBody: Tell your coach what you have available. Your plan stays on this device.
app.errorBody: The app could not read or save your local data. If your data is available, export a backup from Settings.
app.notice: Your data is stored only in this browser. Back it up regularly, especially on iPhone.

home.title:
Make today
count.
home.description: A plan shaped around your strength, your equipment, and the time you have.
home.noSessions: Your first session is one tap away.
home.trainingNote: Take it at your pace. Your coach learns from every session you complete.

generator.title:
What are we
working on?
generator.description: Build a recurring routine that works offline, or ask AI for a workout when you want one.
generator.focusPlaceholder: e.g. pull strength, legs, full body
generator.apiKeyMissing: Add your OpenAI API key here. Your workout details will stay on this screen.
generator.errorKey: That API key was not accepted. Check it in Settings and try again.
generator.errorRate: Rate limit reached. Wait a moment before trying again.
generator.errorNetwork: Could not reach OpenAI. Check your connection and try again.
generator.errorGeneric: Your coach could not make a valid plan. Please try again.
generator.usage: Last request used {{prompt}} input + {{completion}} output tokens.
generator.requesting: Your plan is on its way. You can keep this screen open.

runner.title: Your workout
runner.finishBody: Every rep is progress. Take a moment to log how it felt.
runner.sessionNote: Anything to remember for next time?
runner.notePlaceholder: A win, a challenge, or a small adjustment…
runner.guideSafety: Use a comfortable range and stop if you feel sharp pain.
runner.customGuideSummary: This movement was added for your workout. Check the coach note below for its setup and target.
runner.customGuideSetup: Read any coach note attached to this movement and make sure your equipment and position are stable.
runner.customGuideControl: Start with a small, controlled range. Keep your balance and breathing steady, and follow the reps or time in your plan.
runner.swapHint: Choose an easier or harder catalog option.
runner.noWakeLock: Keep your screen awake to see the timer
runner.plannedNotice: Your workout is ready. Start here, or tap any set below to begin.
runner.loadGuidance: Suggested loads are starting estimates. Adjust them to suit your strength.
runner.noSuggestions: No capability updates suggested this time.

program.offlineBody: Create a routine from the exercise library. It stays on this device and works without an internet connection.
program.offlineNote: When you complete every set at its target, the routine gradually adds a rep or a few seconds next time.
program.aiOptional: Optional: use AI for a workout or plan refinement
program.aiOptionalBody: AI is only used when you choose it. The result is saved here, so your next workout is available offline.
program.refineNext: Use the AI result for the next workout in my weekly plan
program.aiOneOff: Generate a one-off workout with AI

history.title:
Progress,
not perfection.
history.description: Small steps add up. Your past sessions help shape what comes next.
history.emptyTitle: Your story starts with one session.
history.emptyBody: Complete a workout to see your progress take shape.
history.noData: Log this movement in a few sessions to see a trend.
history.removeConfirm: Remove this workout from your history?

settings.title:
Make it
yours.
settings.description: Your coach works best when it knows your setup.
settings.autoSave: Changes save automatically on this device.
settings.apiKeyHelp: Your key stays in this browser and is sent only to api.openai.com when you generate a workout. Anyone with access to this device can use it. Never share exported backups that contain your key.
settings.modelHelp: Model name is sent directly to OpenAI. Default: gpt-5.4-mini.
settings.stylePlaceholder: I enjoy steady progress, short rests, and a mix of strength and mobility…
settings.styleHelp: A few words help the coach choose a style that feels like yours.
settings.capabilitiesDescription: Track a few familiar movements, such as push-ups and pull-ups. Your coach can start conservatively for the rest.
settings.noCapabilities: No movements added yet. You can still build a plan; the coach will start conservatively.
settings.persistentUnsupported: This browser does not offer persistence status
settings.backupInfo: Backups include your profile, workouts, progress, and settings. Your API key is left out unless you choose to include it.
settings.dataError: Could not save that change. Your previous data is still in place.
settings.invalidBackup: This file is not a valid AI Gym Coach backup.

install.title: Keep your training close
install.body: Safari may remove website data after a period of inactivity. Add FORM to your Home Screen to keep its storage separate from Safari and easier to return to.
install.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
install.step3: Open FORM from its new Home Screen icon. Safari and the installed app keep separate data.
install.reminder: Your training data hasn’t been backed up recently. Export it to keep a copy safe.
